name: suspender split fly
description: A fly on the straps with a split stance, opening the arms to work the shoulders and chest.
instructions: Hold the handles and step into a split stance leaning forward.
Keep arms slightly bent and hands in front of you.
Open your arms out wide to the sides.
Squeeze at the end of the stretch without shrugging.
Bring the arms back together under control.
Switch the lead leg halfway through.
